column1: # Mission photographs to compare against the renderer (images in reference/photos/).
# frame: NASA frame number. mission: 8 or 11.
# get: seconds from that mission's range zero (Apollo 8 1968-12-21 12:51:00 UTC, Apollo 11 1969-07-16 13:32:00 UTC); blank if unknown.
# get_lo, get_hi: seconds, the bracket when only a range is known.
# get_src: source of the time and its precision; "unverified" marks our research not yet checked against a primary source.
# lens_mm: focal length. magazine: magazine number/letter. window_or_vehicle: where it was taken from, and by whom.
# scene: our scene number that best fits, blank if none. needs: what the sim lacks to reproduce the frame.
# url: the scan we reduced (apollojournals.org AFJ/ALSJ). credit: NASA/JSC, public domain.
